rationale.campaign_length: 本地库定位53项B59战役关联任务，已经包含Z01续篇相关实体。
rationale.colonization: 主线在月河、帝国机构和既有坎诺地区，而非海外殖民。
rationale.complexity: 形成条件、阶层忠诚、六项议会法案、灾难、帝国政治和后续建设叠加。
rationale.dark_story: 法师夺权、拆塔叛乱和权力斗争沉重，但主线不是献祭或毁灭叙事。
rationale.difficulty: 长线门槛与法师灾难较难，强大后仍有帝国统一要求。
rationale.diplomacy: 形成前月河联盟、形成后帝国首相与宗教政治都需大量协商和操作。
rationale.early_pressure: 若从四自由城出发须先完成月河前传；形成B59后仍需经营阶层与帝国局势。
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: 法师阶层、法师灾难、批准奇械与黑火药转型共同决定阶段节奏。
rationale.narrative_density: 从城邦身份争论、法师危机到安本纳尔统一与国名选择，转折连贯。
rationale.tall_play: 首都法庭、城市工业、交通与宫殿建设是任务的重要门槛。
rationale.trade_economy: 行会、月河城市、工业联合和军需生产构成国家经济骨架。
rationale.warfare: 中后期任务要求跨地区控制与帝国统一，黑火药军队承担扩张。

description.text:
「最伟大的统治者并非仅仅统治一个时期，而是开创一个时代——其遗产之深远、成就之卓著，令古今往来者皆黯然失色。他们深知：庇护者的终极遗产，就镌刻在被庇护者的命运之中。」
——瓦卢斯纳的托马斯，「绿衣鳏夫」，《为政之道》
description.text_en:
“The greatest rulers preside not over a mere reign but an Era, a period which eclipses those ahead and behind in its profundity and prolificity. They understand that the legacy of the patron is his clients.”
Tomás of Vallusna, ‘The Statesman’

description.text:
「风格之仿效必先师其形，进而得其神。当我们以古达梅里亚正规市集为蓝本构筑柱廊时，我们同样受到那些曾在柱影间流转的智语机锋启发，以及那种我们试图重现的结构所赋予的生活方式。论辩传统的延续，蓬勃的公共生活，乃至喧腾的抗争呐喊——皆因我们再次选择为它们预留栖身之所。」
——萨曼·弗尔巴恩,《石之生命》
description.text_en:
“The imitation of style necessitates the imitation of form, and therefore of function. When we build a colonnade inspired by the formal markets of Old Dameria, we are inspired also by the conversation held along that colonnade, the type of life enabled by the structure we seek to recreate. The rhetorical tradition, the vibrant public life, even the raucous protest – all are made possible by the decision, made once again, to build space for them.”
Saman of Fowlbarn, ‘The Life Of Stone’

description.text:
「即便在那些未将政权让渡于行会支持的市议员协会控制之下的地区，行会也早已是东月神之首地区城市生活的基本单元，这比帕沙埃内作为一个有组织的国家出现要早得多。

此种传统衍生出三重深远影响：其一，催生了某种社团民主制的法典化理念——坚信社会最佳形态诞生于代表不同民众集体的团体间相互制衡，即便这些团体最终仍须臣服于君主或所谓『执行行会』；其二，培育了以经济繁荣为导向的务实精神，造就帕沙埃内锱铢必较、闻名于世的『商人外交』；其三，孕育了对城市化进程与产业垂直整合的执着追求。」
——西尔瓦德·多夫，《坎诺经济史》
description.text_en:
“Even in those realms which had not subordinated their government to an association of guild-backed aldermen, the Guild had been the fundamental unit of urban life in the Eastern Dameshead long before Pashainé’s emergence as a coherent state.

This had three major consequences. First, the codification of a sort of corporate democracy, a belief that society was best forged under a competing set of mutually-exerted pressures, by groups representing collectives of the population - even if these were subject to a monarch or a so-called ’Executive Guild’. Second, an emphasis on economic prosperity, the brass tacks ‘shopkeeper diplomacy’ for which Pashainé became notorious. Third, a relentless focus on urbanisation and the vertical integration of industry.”
Silvard Dove, ‘An Economic History of Cannor’

description.text:
「诗人米利安曾言，帕沙埃内的高贵无与伦比——她继承了弗恩父亲的勇气，又秉持着母亲达梅里亚的端方。而身为次女的我，似乎只承袭了情欲与固执。」
「珍妮」杰娜娅·卡德斯娜·西纳·贝拉凯尔，《堕落伯爵夫人回忆录》
description.text_en:
“The poet Milian said that the Pashainéy is uniquely noble, having inherited the bravery of his Vernman father and the dignity of his Damerian mother. As a second daughter, I seem to have been left with the libido and stubbornness.”
Genaia ‘Geni’ Cadesna sina Bellacaire, ‘Memoirs Of A Fallen Countess’

description.text:
「试看科琳教与摄政王庭之间的冲突，曾使整个河谷地带割裂至此般境地。复观此地子民，既文修智启又热忱参政，将弥合神学裂痕奉为政道急务。终视揭秘会，组织架构效法行会自愿联合之根基。在这哈兰世界，再没有哪个族群，不仅愿接纳其信条纲目，更能从根本上承袭揭秘会组织精义之信众。」
——利安德·贝拉克，《卫道书》
description.text_en:
“Consider the conflict between Corinism and the Court which had so split the Valley. Consider, then, an unusually literate and engaged populace with a political impetus to see theological ruptures healed. Consider finally the Ravelian Lodge, which in its structure mimics the voluntary association basis of the guild. No population on Halann was more ready to embrace not merely the articles of belief but the basic organisational structure of Ravelianism.”
Leande Bellac, ‘Apologetics’

description.text:
「十八世纪的钟摆荡过月河，『翠绿之灾』的慢性蚕食终现狰狞全貌。曾经坎诺最膏腴的沃土尸斑遍布，耕地两年方得薄收，伴生的壤毒更将谷地仅存的天然森林噬作枯骨。乡野大流散由是启始，农村人口大规模迁移，使帕沙埃内的城市化进一步加深，帕沙埃内在剧痛中早产出现代都会的雏形——砖缝里开出的恶之花，是日后百年劳工政治的血色温床：咖啡馆的激进私语与街垒的呛人硝烟，自此成为周期性文明痉挛的预兆性颤栗。今日河谷难觅为卡米尔·席尔穆纳歌功颂德者，然这片土地的每道褶皱里，都已深深烙上那个狂人的印记。」
——卢卡斯·西尔·贝拉凯尔，《丁香河史》，第二卷
description.text_en:
“Over the course of the eighteenth century, the slowly aggregating impact of the Verdancy became more and more clear across the entire Luna watershed. Land which had once been among the most fertile in Cannor gave harvest perhaps once in two years, while the concomitant soil pollution devastated the Valley’s few remaining natural forests. The result was an exodus of the population from the countryside and an even greater urbanisation of Pashainé, inadvertently birthing a contentious café and street culture; this would dominate the labour politics of the following hundred years, erupting again and again into civil unrest. You will find few along the Valley who have much to say in praise of Camir Silmuna, but our land is indelibly marked by his legacy.”
Lucas síl Bellacaire, The History of the Lilac River, Vol. II

description.text:
「吾民，勿惧死亡！勿惧与勇者为伍，勿怯与同胞同行！我们正处于巫师王时代——法杖即真理的时代——其威仪看似不可撼动。然我等皆知，法师亦有死穴可破。

三百载前烽烟为证，当齐射战术的枪焰首度能与火球术的弧光相抗衡时，我们就已知晓；二百年前铁律昭然，当我们首次得知那种辉煌物质——当时仅在极东之地可得——能抵消他们不劳而获的恩赐时，我们就已知晓；而如今我们也已知晓——他们催长万物的仪式，他们许诺的永恒丰收，那场『翠绿之灾』！，已把昔日葱郁的生命之地化作荒芜草原。此乃他们惯行之道！荼毒大地，污染清泉，为独踞那虚妄王座，竟不惜将哈兰娜馈赠的丰饶付之一炬。

且听！诚然——今日或当赴死。然吾等共赴黄泉，彼辈孤魂永堕！」
——帕勒多克斯的卡里克，最后的演说
description.text_en:
“Do not fear death, my people. Fear nothing which you do in the company of brave souls; fear nothing which you do among your fellow citizens! We live in the time of the Mage-Emperors – in the era of the staff – and its power seems absolute. But we know these mages can die.

We knew it three hundred years ago, when the discipline of the fusillade first began to rival the arc of the fireball. We knew it two hundred years ago, when first we learned of that glorious substance, then accessible only so very far away, which could countermand their unearned gifts. And we know it now – now that their ritual of growth, their promise of endless harvest, has wrought a desolate steppe where once there was only verdant life. It is what they do! Addle the land, poison the water, wreck the bountiful Halann we share for the slightest chance at a lonely throne.

Hear me! It’s true – we may die today. But we die together, while they die alone.”
Carric of Paredocks, Final Address

description.text: 就来自我们城市的冒险者数量而言，梅尼博尔仅次于安本科斯特本身。从德尔温到艾斯塞斯提尔，东月神之首及其他地区充满希望的英雄们涌向我们的客栈和酒馆，开始他们的冒险生活，并在此过程中成立了强大而有声望的佣兵团，如梅尼博尔自由兵团。
description.text_en: Menibór is second only to Anbenncóst itself in terms of how many adventurers hail from our city. From Derwing to Aiscestir, hopeful heroes of the Eastern Dameshead and beyond flock to our inns and taverns to begin their lives as adventurers, forming powerful and prestigious companies such as the Menibór Free Company in the process.

description.text: 在统治权之战期间，古塔的法师和英勇要塞的骑士经常在我们的城市附近发生冲突，他们的魔法有几次威胁到我们城墙的完整性。为了对付他们，我们创造了小型的反魔法结界，安装在墙上，让我们的战士佩戴，让他们正确地保护梅尼博尔免受周围蔓延的奥术混乱。
description.text_en: During the Wars of Rule, the Magisters of Oldtower and the knights of Valiant Keep frequently clashed near our city, their magics risking the integrity of our walls on several occasions. To deal with them, small anti-magic wards were created to be mounted on the walls and worn by our warriors, allowing them to properly defend Menibór from the arcane chaos spreading around her.

description.text:
没有什么能比一份配上厚厚的香肠的布里奇葡萄酒更能安抚疲惫的冒险家了！

更专业的叫法是简单的「梅尼博尔」，这是一种中度烈性的红酒，以辛辣和高酸度而闻名，并在坎诺的大胆人物中得到了强烈的喜爱。
description.text_en:
Nothing soothes a tired adventurer more than a serving of Bridgewine with a hefty sausage!

Known more professionally as simply 'Menibór', it is a moderately strong red wine that is known for its spicy notes and high acidity - and has found strong favor amongst the bolder characters of Cannor.

description.text: 自从达梅里亚共和国垮台我们的城市就没几个人能坚持多久了。好几次，达梅里亚和弗恩的军队都被冒险者兵团驱逐出了这座城市，并卷入了为夺回她而进行的血腥战争。尽管我们已经在帝国定居下来，但我们的邻居们都清楚，为了我们继续保持自治地位，梅尼博尔会付出多大的努力。
description.text_en: Ever since the fall of the Damerian Republic our city has been one that few can manage to hold onto for long. Several times Damerian and Vernman forces alike were banished from the city by the adventurer companies and embroiled in bloody wars to reclaim her. Even though we've settled into the Empire, our neighbors know well the lengths a Menibórian will go to for our continued autonomous status.

description.text: 环道是月河盆地最著名的酒馆，只招待最传奇的英雄，他们经常聚集在那里讨论国外发生的事情和荣誉。该机构的所有者会迅速通知我们任何值得注意的消息，他们总是确保我们的市议会的影响仍在环道中。
description.text_en: The Loop is the most famed tavern in the Luna Basin, only catering to the most legendary heroes, who frequently gather there to discuss happenings and glories abroad. The proprietors of the establishment are quick to inform us of anything of note that they hear, always ensuring the reach of our city council remains in The Loop.

description.text: 很久以前，河石氏族的矮人被雇来建造我们城市中横跨月河的诸多桥梁，并留下来维护这些桥梁。随着城市在他们家和工作室周围的发展，他们扩大了自己的影响力，在梅尼博尔建造了几乎所有的建筑，并作为城市的主要建筑师和工程师运营至今。
description.text_en: The dwarves of the Riverstone Clan were hired long ago to construct the many bridges that cross the Luna in our city, and they stayed behind to maintain them. As the city grew around their homes and workshops they expanded their influence, constructing virtually every structure in Menibór and operating as the city's primary architects and engineers to this day.

description.text: 每个来自梅尼博尔的冒险者都梦想着有朝一日，自己的名字与雕像能陈列在英勇者大厅那神圣的长廊里。这座宏伟的纪念馆，献给所有为荣光与正义而牺牲的英雄，廊中陈列的姓名与半身像，有些甚至能追溯到龙醒之前。英勇者大厅是城中最负盛名、最受敬重的巍峨建筑。
description.text_en: The dream of every adventurer from Menibór is to have their statues and names featured in the hallowed corridors of the Hall of the Gallant, a vast memorial dedicated to those heroes that lost their lives fighting for glory and justice. With names and busts dating back to before the Dragonwake, it is the most well known and respected edifice in the city.

description.text: 为了防止达梅里亚完全统治海洋，古弗恩王国在纳普斯湾建立了一个热闹的兵工厂。虽然这个王国可能很久以前就灭亡了，但基础设施依然存在，让我们可以继续快速生产船只，在另一个君主的统治下。
description.text_en: To prevent complete Damerian domination of the seas the old kingdom of Verne had established a bustling arsenal in Napesbay. Though the kingdom might've fallen long ago the infrastructure still stands, allowing us to continue producing vessels at a rapid rate, albeit under a different liege.

description.text: 月神之颈的海盗知道避开纳普斯湾的船只，因为几个世纪以来，许多邪恶的海盗被我们的枪炮打入海底。
description.text_en: Pirates of the Damesneck know to steer clear of Napesbayer vessels, for many a villainous corsair has been sent the sea floor by our guns over the centuries.

description.text:
几个世纪以来，纳普斯湾一直是帝国第二舰队的所在地，经常被称为纳普斯舰队，与月神之颈对岸的内克利夫呼应。然而，当丁香战争爆发时，我们知道，如果舰队仍在皇帝手中，它只会让我们成为战争的目标。因此，当要求船只离开港口的命令下达时，我们的官员就扣押了这些船只，宣布它们是城市的财产，并追捕那些试图逃跑的船只。当席尔穆纳感到心烦意乱的时候，更大的问题把他们的注意力从我们身上吸引过来，而内克利夫的舰队在我们的位置上表现得很好。

至少对于大多数冲突来说。
description.text_en:
For centuries Napesbay was the home of the secondary Imperial fleet, frequently referred to as the Napesfleet, mirroring Neckcliffe across the Damesneck. When the Lilac Wars came roaring however, we knew that the fleet would only serve to make us a target should it remain in the hands of the Emperor. Thus, when the order came for the ships to leave port our officials seized the ships, declaring them property of the city and chasing down the ones that attempted to flee. While the Silmuna were understandably upset, bigger problems drew their attention from us and the fleet of Neckcliffe served well in our stead.

For most of the conflict anyway.

description.text: 小月河（皮尔卢纳河）沿岸水流平缓，分布着片片葡萄园与酿酒厂——这些宁静的土地属于来自梅尼博尔的退役冒险家们。这里的乡村更像是葡萄酒领主的庄园，他们是纳普斯湾的主要雇主，仅次于兵工厂与帝国海军。
description.text_en: Along the gentle and slow-moving Pírluna are vineyards and wineries, tranquil slices of land owned by retired adventurers from Menibór. With a countryside more akin to the estate of a Wine Lord, they're one of the main employers in Napesbay, only after the arsenal and the navy.

description.text: 纳普斯湾的鲁本是一位勇敢而勇悍的船长，他领导了弗恩的殖民努力，成为坎诺最著名的探险家之一。他当然没有忘记自己的家乡，带着金银回国在纳普斯湾建立了一个新的殖民贸易公司，从埃兰提尔带回了贸易。
description.text_en: Ruben of Napesbay was a daring and dashing captain, who led the colonial efforts of Verne, becoming one of the most famous explorers in Cannor. He of course didn't forget his home city, returning with gold and silver to establish a new colonial trading company in Napesbay, bringing trade from Aelantir back home.

description.text: 许多被纳普斯湾俘获的海盗船长都很老练，如果不好好利用他们的才能，那将是一种浪费。通过建立一个恢复计划，我们可以把这些吵闹的掠夺者变成纳普斯舰队的骄傲的海军上将，为最终摆脱海洋中的前战友而战斗。
description.text_en: Many of the pirate captains the captains of Napesbay captures are quite skilled, and it would be a waste to not make use of their talents. By establishing a rehabilitation program we can turn these rowdy raiders into proud admirals of the Napesfleet, fighting to finally rid the sea of their former comrades.

description.text: 由于纳普斯湾公司运营良好，纳普斯湾舰队保持海洋远离海盗，纳普斯湾已迅速发展成为月神之颈最著名的港口之一。许多涌向埃兰提尔的冒险者和定居者都是通过我们的城市离开坎诺的，还有无数人搬到这里，在国内外建立新的企业。确实，这是纳普斯湾的黄金时代。
description.text_en: With the Napesbay Company running well and the Napesfleet keeping the seas clear of piracy, Napesbay has swiftly grown into one of the most prominent ports in the Damesneck. Many of the adventurers and settlers flocking to Aelantir leave Cannor through our city, and countless more have been moving here to establish new businesses, at home and abroad. Truly, this is Napesbay's golden age.

description.text: 蓝鹿周围一直都是野心勃勃的领主，渴望利用月河的财富。许多想要征服我们的人被我们的城市拒之门外，不是因为刀剑，而是因为语言的力量。我们的官员是谈判和平与和解的专家，即使是与最好战的军阀谈判，使我们的人民免受战争的恐怖。
description.text_en: Bluehart has always been surrounded by ambitious lords, eager to feast upon the riches of the Luna. Many a would-be conqueror have been turned away from our city, though not through the sword, but through the power of words. Our officials are experts in negotiating peace and reconciliation even with the most belligerent warlords, keeping our people safe from the horrors of combat.

description.text: 我们的城市最初是作为达梅里亚第21军团，也被称为第21「鹿」军团，的一个军营建立的，当共和国沦陷于龙醒时，前指挥官控制了局势，让惊慌失措的平民涌向他的保护下，并在突然变得无法无天的边境维持稳定。后来，他被称为鹿领主，是和平与法律的典范，当达梅里亚王国从共和国的废墟中崛起时，他欣然将新城市蓝鹿交给他们统治，就像他统治时一样平静地在睡梦中死去。我们希望继续他的遗产，作为一股善意的力量，不管我们周围的土地上有什么恐怖。
description.text_en: Our city was originally founded as a legionary camp of the 21st Legion of Dameria, also known as the Legion XXI Hart. When the Republic fell to the Dragonwake, the former commander took control of the situation, allowing panicked civilians to flock to his protection and enforcing stability across the suddenly lawless frontier. In time he became known as The Hartlord, a paragon of peace and law, and when the Kingdom of Dameria rose from the ashes of the Republic, he readily submitted the new city of Bluehart to their rule, dying in his sleep as peacefully as he reigned. We hope to continue his legacy, acting as a force for goodwill despite whatever horrors wrack the lands around us.

description.text: 除了穆纳斯港，我们的城市是月河上最大的城市。作为从威克斯山顺流而下的主要贸易目的地，蓝鹿的商人们在舒适的家中找到交易市场并不困难。
description.text_en: With the exception of Port Munas, our city is the largest on the Luna River. A prime destination for trade flowing downstream from the Wexhills, Blueharter merchants have little trouble finding markets to trade with from the comfort of home.

description.text: 旧军团营地被称为西姆塞斯提尔，尽管它已经有很长一段时间没有被用于最初的战时目的。自从鹿领主统治以来，该建筑一直被用作外交综合体，为外国政要提供舒适的住宿，并为紧张的谈判提供安全的房间。
description.text_en: The old legion camp is known as the Cymcestir, though it hasn't been used for its original wartime purposes for quite some time. Ever since the reign of The Hartlord, the compound has been used as a diplomatic complex, providing comforting accommodations for foreign dignitaries and secure rooms for tense negotiations.

description.text: 每个成员都有第21「鹿」军团的直系血统，第21军团之子是蓝鹿勇敢的哨兵，只有他们被允许在城市范围内携带武器。据说他们每个人都以十人般的凶残作战，决心保卫他们祖先为之战斗的城市，保卫他们的子孙将在这里长大，他们的子孙也将继续保卫这座城市。
description.text_en: Each member tracing direct lineage to the soldiers of the Legion XXI Hart, the Sons of the XXI are the brave sentinels of Bluehart, they alone are permitted to bear arms within city limits. They're said to fight with the ferocity of ten men each, determined to safeguard the city their ancestors fought for, that their children will grow up in, and that their descendants will continue to defend.

description.text: 当混乱在城市周围酝酿时，没有人能越过我们的城门。在这个城市里是一种宁静的氛围，基本上没有受到任何灾难的侵扰。
description.text_en: While turmoil brews around the city, none reaches past our city gates. Within the city is an atmosphere of tranquility, largely untouched by whatever calamity plagues the rest of the Empire.

description.text: 1604年，西姆塞斯提尔扩大并改建为奥罗伊盖努尔学院，这是安本纳尔组织内部酝酿的紧张局势的结果。建制派的教授们在培养下一代政治家和使者来充当和平使者的过程中找到了巨大的满足感，他们准备好修复跨越帝国的桥梁，并帮助治愈过去的创伤。
description.text_en: The Cymcestir was expanded and converted into the Olóiegéanur Academy in 1604 as a result of simmering tensions within the fabric of Anbennar. The professors of the establishment find great gratification in training the next generation of statesmen and emissaries to act as agents of peace, ready to mend broke bridges across the Empire and assist in healing the wounds of the past.

description.text: 贝拉凯尔最独特、最具传奇色彩的建筑是贝拉克岩要塞，最早由弗恩国王贝拉克·弗尔恩在587年建造，作为对抗达梅里亚的边境要塞。几个世纪以来，它一直抵抗着北方的野心，直到917年，它从弗尔恩人手中被夺走，作为抵抗她原来的主人的堡垒，直到在术士王之战的战争中被包围和占领。尽管贝拉克岩有着漫长而动荡的历史，但它仍然一如既往地坚固，作为一座强大的壁垒，继续守卫着周围的土地。
description.text_en: The most unique and storied structure of Bellacaire is the looming fortress of Bellac's Rock, first built by the King of Verne, Bellac Vernid, in 587 AA as a border fortress against Dameria. For centuries it stood against the ambitions of the north, up until it was seized from the Vernids in 917 AA, acting as a bastion against her original owners until it came under siege and occupation during the War of the Sorcerer-King. Despite its long and tumultuous history, Bellac's Rock is as sturdy as ever, a mighty citadel that continues to guard the lands around it.

description.text: 当战争的阴云笼罩在上月河时，贝拉凯尔与其沿河自由市的同伴们缔结了一项中立协议。尽管这份协议最终并未持续太久，但沿月河畔那短暂的团结时刻，成为了每位贝拉凯尔人心中的希望之光，他们渴望重铸这样的联盟，以锻造出一个强大到足以保护自己免受他人冲突侵扰的王国。
description.text_en: When the winds of war blew across the Upper Luna, Bellacaire organized a neutrality pact with her fellow Free Cities of the river. Though it was ultimately short lived, the brief moment of unity along the Luna is a goal every Bellacairey hopes to replicate, to forge a realm strong enough to protect itself from being pulled into the conflicts of others.

description.text: 尽管我们的城市在丁香战争中宣布中立，但在冲突的最后几天，她成为了一场残酷但鼓舞人心的战斗的地点。最近支持玫瑰党的阴险的塞斯蒂朗德向这座城市发起进攻，而加莱因也采取了同样的行动，两大势力都在为自己的野心而觊觎贝拉凯尔。他们在我们的城门外相遇，在血腥的混战中发生冲突，而我们的战士则在战场上保卫城市。四天三夜之后，入侵的军队都被迫撤退，因为贝拉凯尔的守卫确保了她将继续自由地站立。
description.text_en: Despite our city's declared neutrality in the Lilac Wars, in the final days of the conflict she became the site of a brutal, yet inspiring, battle. The treacherous Cestiranders, recently supporters of the Rose Party, charged towards the city while the Galéinni did the same, both powers seeking to seize Bellacaire for their own ambitions. They met outside our gates, clashing in bloody melee while our own warriors took the field to defend the city. After four days and three nights, the invading forces were both forced to withdraw, for the guard of Bellacaire had ensured she would continue to stand free.

name.text_en: Battle of the Salt and Lance

description.text: 在贝拉克岩陷落后，达梅里亚人大多在月河河畔定居，沿着平静的河畔建立了一个贵族区。远离要塞投下的巨大阴影，在夜晚的月光下，它是城市中最负盛名的社区。
description.text_en: Running along the Luna River, the Lunawalk is where most Damerians settled after the fall of Bellac's Rock, establishing a patrician district along the gentle and serene banks. Far from reach of the great shadow cast by the Rock and gently lit by the moon at night, it is the most prestigious neighborhood in the city.

description.text: 在城市的另一边，远离月街的豪宅，德拉斯伯德的工作室和实验室日夜忙碌。这个地区的地精生产的奇怪的小玩意和小饰品令民众惊叹不已，市政府在很大程度上让地精随意创新和发明，只要他们执行安全的操作和程序。
description.text_en: On the other side of the city, far from the opulent abodes of the Lunawalk, the workshops and laboratories of the Drabsburd buzz and churn night and day. The strange gadgets and trinkets produced by the gnomes of the district are awe-inspiring to the populace, and the city government largely leaves the gnomes to innovate and invent at will, so long as they enforce safe practices and procedures.

description.text: 最后，谁在摄政王庭的宝座上真的不重要了，因为当我们离开这个世界的时候，我们都会知道的。在这里，你可以看到阿德恩信徒和科琳信徒生活在和平中，摆脱了驱使他们的宗教同胞在城外作战的教条仇恨。
description.text_en: In the end, it truly doesn't matter who rests upon the throne of the Regent Court, for all of us shall know for sure when we pass from this world. Here one can find Adeanics and Corinites living in peace, free from the dogmatic hatred that drives their religious compatriots to battle outside the city.

description.text: 科琳联盟和阿德恩联盟之间的战争的恐怖已经留下了无数的难民和孤儿，而帝国的大多数人满足于让他们默默地忍受。这对我们是不利的。「粉红条纹」是一个总部设在贝拉凯尔的组织，帮助和培养那些被战争和灾难摧毁的人，不管他们的信仰、忠诚、种族或其他什么。他们已经在安本纳尔建立了特许学校，照顾那些被落下的难民和孤儿。
description.text_en: The horrors of the war between the Corinite and Adeanic Leagues has left countless refugees and orphans in its wake, and the majority of the Empire is content to let them suffer in silence. This will not stand for us. The Pink Stripe is an organization based in Bellacaire to assist and nurture those devastated by war and disaster, regardless of creed, allegiance, race, or otherwise. Already they've established charters across Anbennar, looking after those that have been left behind.

description.text: 没有其他国家像我们这样直接面对魔法专制的幽灵。巫师王的永恒威胁已困扰坎诺千年，而唯有我们展现出足够的决心，直面这一必然重现的危险。结果如何？一个守护人民的国家，一个抵制学者圈子中阴险叛乱言论的国家。我们与黑火药的渊源实至名归，正是凭借公民持枪的奇迹，我们终于与法师平起平坐，而正是通过步枪的枪口，我们终于让平凡之人获得了安全。
description.text_en: No other state has so directly confronted the spectre of magical autocracy as our own. The perennial threat of the Witch-King has haunted Cannor for a thousand years, and only we have proven resolute enough to confront this inevitably recurring danger. The result? A state which defends its people, which stands against the conniving, seditious chatter of the scholar’s den. Our association with blackpowder is well-earned, for it is by the miracle of the citizen’s firearm that we have finally drawn equal with the mage, and out of the barrel of the rifle that we have finally made the humble safe.

description.text:
在来自坎诺各地的政要聚集的人群中，在他们忠诚的支持者和胜利的将军们的出席下，安本纳尔集权后的第一任皇帝在银月的大宴会厅发表了演讲，该宴会厅为这一场合重新进行了装饰：宣布一个真正统一的帝国。他告诉他们，安本纳尔的未来将由银和钢来决定。

一张张五颜六色的脸眯着眼睛，抿起嘴唇——未来？皇帝说得好像伟大的任务还在前面，而不是在他们身后。他能说什么呢？这是一个简单而有效的修辞伎俩——好奇的听众们全神贯注地听着皇帝阐述他们的话的含义。

银是帝国的颜色，是其旗帜的颜色，是其钱币的颜色，是其外交的颜色。银代表月亮，或是代表卡斯特罗斯。半精灵白银家族留下了深远的影响，当然，他们的血统亦是如此。驱逐术士王的英雄银色大队的记忆在歌曲和故事中延续。银色的武器让邪恶无处遁形，银色的巧舌让帝国诸侯们走到一起。

钢更简单。弗恩的长矛、范伯里行会的火枪、吉伯德的枪支都是用钢打造的。钢来自泰尔盖尔的铸造厂和工匠之砧的锻炉。半百种不同的军事传统和工业实践的经验将为帝国迈向未来提供源源不绝的动力。
description.text_en:
Amongst an assembled crowd of dignitaries from all of Cannor, attended by their loyal supporters and victorious generals, the emperor of the now centralized Anbennar delivered a speech in the Grand Ballroom of the Silver Moon, which had been redecorated for the occasion: the proclamation of a truly united Empire. He told them that the future of Anbennar would be decided by silver and steel.

A colorful sea of faces squinted and pursed their lips - the future? The Emperor spoke as if the great task was still ahead, not behind them. What could he mean? It was a simple yet effective rhetorical gambit - the curious audience listened in rapt attention as the Emperor expounded on the meaning of their words.

Silver is the Empire's color, of its banners, of its coinage, of its diplomacy. Silver for the moon, or perhaps for Castellos. The influence of the half-elven Silver Families runs deep, as does, of course, their blood descent. The memory of the heroic Silver Band that expelled the Sorcerer-King lives on in song and story. Silver arms kept evil at bay, and silver tongues brought the imperial princes together.

Steel is simpler. Steel for the spears of Verne, for the muskets of the Vanbury Guild, for the guns of Giberd. Steel from the foundries of Telgeir and the forge of Anvilwright. The lessons of half a hundred different military traditions and industrial practices will power the Empire's march into the future.

description.text:
「安本纳尔」这个词在精灵语中意为「交融」或「团结」。在其核心，帝国的创始原则是一个理想主义的梦想，即非常不同的人可以走到一起。人类、精灵、矮人、半身人、侏儒——团结在一起。然而，这个梦想随着空位期的结束，被成千上万的人用鲜血换走了。三十年的和平之后是统治权之战，以及三十年的混乱和内战。1284年，帝国议会和选侯团成立，让帝国的各色人等都有发言权。

伊斯特拉洛尔，代表东部的贵族。
珍珠边地，代表西部的贵族。
比佩克，代表半身人，帝国境内数量最多的少数种族。
银锻炉，代表矮人，哈沃拉尔山脉的伟大矿工和匠人。
月港，代表精灵，帝国境内最有影响力的少数种族。
月神之冠，代表商人阶层，并在一段时间内代表北方的贵族。
最后，是代表法师以及帝国的前管理机构的魔法师议会。

然而，这也导致了冲突，达梅里亚大公席尔穆纳家族实际上通过其合法附庸选侯伊斯特拉洛尔和珍珠边地的支持，成功垄断了鸽座——这种情况是阿巴兰、威克斯和其他强大的领主永远无法完全接受的。丁香战争（1348-1443）几乎将帝国彻底撕裂。但是，尽管困难重重，帝国仍然团结一致，永远在一起。
description.text_en:
The word 'Anbennar' means 'communion' or 'unity' in Elven. At its heart, the founding principle of the empire is an idealistic dream that very different people could come together. Humans, elves, dwarves, halflings, gnomes - together. And yet this dream was bartered for in the blood of thousands with the end of the Interregnum. After thirty years of peace came the Wars of Rule, and thirty years of chaos and civil war. In 1284, the Imperial Parliament and the Electoral College were established to give the multifarious people of the Empire a voice.

Istralore, to represent the nobility of the east.
Pearlsedge, to represent the nobility of the west.
Beepeck, to represent the halflings, the most numerous minority.
Silverforge, to represent the dwarves, the great miners and craftsmen of the Havoral mountains.
Moonhaven, to represent the elves, the most influential minority.
Damescrown, to represent the merchant class, and, in time, the northern nobility.
And finally, the Magisterium, representing the mages, and the former governing body of the Empire.

Yet this too led to conflict, with the Silmuna Grand Dukes of Dameria practically guaranteed the Dove Throne by the support of the electors Istralore and Pearlsedge, their leal vassals - a situation that the powerful lords of Arbaran, Wex, and others would never fully accept. The Lilac Wars (1348-1443) very nearly tore the Empire apart for good. But despite all the odds, the Empire stands united, together, forever.

description.text:
条条大路通向卡斯托纳斯，但哈兰的诸海却通向月神之首。早在灰烬天空之日来临之前，这片平静的内海沿岸就已然布满了充满活力的贸易城市。灾难和随后发生的达梅里亚共和国、卡斯塔诺和侏儒议会之间的「落星战争」使该地区遭到了破坏，但这并没有持续太久。财富将继续从迪文哈尔流向月神之首两旁不断增长的城市。龙醒、白色瘟疫——在历史的进程中，这些灾难都敌不过地理和经济。旧城为新城腾出了空间，或者至少是提供了建筑材料。侏儒统治的比佩克被重建为半身人统治的比佩克。艾伦河口适合建城，于是一座城市拔地而起；不管维特斯克是由卡斯托纳斯还是加韦顿统治，也不管它的城楼是白色还是黑色。达梅纳斯让位于达穆森，而后者当大海将精灵的残余舰队带到月神之耳时，它被称为安本科斯特。

真的，这些宁静的海岸见证了历史的浪潮在它们之间的碰撞和汹涌。这里有帝国及其人民的遗产和命运。正如王冠诸族口耳相传那般，统治者创造历史，而财富缔造统治者。安本纳尔帝国将统治月神之首，并随之支配世界的财富。而接下来还会有什么呢？
description.text_en:
All roads led to Castonath, but the seas of Halann lead to the Dameshead. Even before the Day of Ashen Skies, the shores of this calm inner sea teemed with vibrant trading cities. The Ruin and the subsequent War of the Falling Stars between the Damerian Republic, Castanor, and the Gnomish Hierarchy laid waste to the region, but not for long. Wealth would continue to flow from the Divenhal to the ever-growing cities lining the Dameshead. The Dragonwake, the White Pestilence - in the course of history, these disasters were no match for geography and economics. The old cities made room, or at least provided construction material, for the new. The gnome-ruled Beepeck was rebuilt into a halfling-ruled Beepeck. The mouth of the Alen suited a city, and so a city arose; it did not matter if Vertesk was ruled from Castonath or Gaweton, or if its citadel tower was white or black. Damenath gave way to Damucen, which became known as Anbenncóst when the seas brought the elven Remnant Fleet to the Damesear.

Truly, these tranquil shores have seen the tides of history crash and rage amongst them. There is the legacy and the destiny of the Empire and its peoples. As the Crownsmen saying goes, a ruler makes history, but wealth makes a ruler. The Empire of Anbennar shall rule the Dameshead, and with it, the wealth of the world. And what else could come next?

description.text: 哲学家和政治家都对国家权力的绝对化、权力集中于单一机构的现象感到担忧——这种担忧并非毫无道理。专制主义，如巫师王或那些癫狂的王子所体现的，必然导致不公。然而，代表社会中众多机构和团体的国家，平衡其「公民行会」中各种群体的国家，才是唯一合法的权力行使者。允许这样一个代表性国家的权力被稀释，本身就是对那些企图破坏民主的人的让步。为了捍卫这样的代表性国家，正义之士将战斗到最后一刻。
description.text_en: Philosophers and politicians alike have feared the totality of the state, the unification of power in a single body – this is not unwise. Autocracy, as expressed by the Witch-King or the swivel-eyed Prince, inevitably leads to injustice. Yet the state which represents the many bodies and institutions of society, which balances the many groupings of its citizen guilds, is the only legitimate wielder of power. To allow the power of such a representative state to be diluted is itself a concession to those who would undermine democracy. In defence of such a representative state, the righteous will fight to the very death.

description.text:
变革之风已经吹到了哈兰，安本纳尔的最终统一将是一个永远为后人所瞩目的事件。但安本纳尔不是一阵风，短暂，如同过眼云烟。

帝国的纹章是按四分法排列的：在第一和第四部分是达梅里亚的精灵化月亮，这是王国与随后大公国的象征。在纹章学中，这种定位通常是为最有声望的头衔保留的。月亮代表了帝国在达梅里亚共和国的根基，在月神之耳统治，其议会与古老的元老院相呼应。非正式地，而且只是在以前的程度上，月亮代表白银家族，特别是席尔穆纳家族。第二部分是银龙，卡斯特罗斯，代表卡斯塔诺，人类种族的古老帝国和月神之首的最初统治者。第三部分是贾赫帝国的黄金凤凰，其后裔杰西丝是统治现在形成帝国之地的最后一位大帝；她于1161年驾崩，其国度随之崩溃，进入了空位期。徽章上还有一只鸽子，叼着一根树枝：象征着和平。

达梅里亚、卡斯塔诺和凤凰帝国——安本纳尔的遗产覆盖了哈尔坎的大部分地区。即使是它在月神之首周围的核心领土，在历史上也是难以治理的——正如「统一者」所清楚的那样。重生的安本纳尔必须进一步改革其行政管理，采用新的技术和移动学说，以应对整个帝国的任何需求和任何威胁。
description.text_en:
The winds of change have come to Halann, and the ultimate unification of Anbennar will be an event forever marked for posterity. But Anbennar is not a gust of wind, ephemeral and passing.

The Empire's Coat of Arms is marshaled by quartering: in the first and fourth with the elvenized moon of Dameria, the symbol of the Kingdom, then the Grand Duchy of Dameria. In heraldry, this positioning is often reserved for the most prestigious titles. The moon represents the roots of the Empire in the Damerian Republic, ruled from Damesear, with a Parliament hearkening to the old Senate. Informally, and to a degree only formerly, the moon represents the Silver Families, especially the Silmunas. In the second quarter is the silver dragon, Castellos, for Castanor, the ancient empire of humankind and the original rulers of the Dameshead. In the third quarter is the golden phoenix of the Jaherian Empire, whose scion, Jexis, was the last great emperor to rule the lands that now form the Empire; her realm collapsed into the Interregnum with her death in 1161 AA. The inescutcheon features a dove carrying a branch: a symbol of peace.

Dameria, Castanor, and the Phoenix Empire - the heritage of Anbennar covers much of Halcann. Even its core territories around the Dameshead have been historically difficult to govern - as the unifier knew well. The reborn Anbennar must reform its administration even further, adopt new techniques and mobile doctrine to respond to any needs, any threats throughout the Empire.

description.text:
月港的一个精灵正在教他的孩子学习通用语和精灵语：「Unity的意思是安本纳尔（团结）！」精灵孩子问道：「那么......那么安本纳尔是什么意思？」他的父亲笑着回答：「哦，你这傻丫头！安本纳尔的意思是一群华而不实的贵族，在任何事情上都无法达成一致！」

很久以前，安本纳尔帝国是一个笑话。又一个失败的政治事业。理论上十分完美，但注定要被扫进历史的垃圾堆。

不再如此了。

德利安·白笠的梦想不再是一道简单的幻景，在清晨醒来时便会被遗忘。月神之首将获得和平。坎诺也会获得和平。全哈兰世界都将获得和平。

最开明可敬的皇帝，达梅里亚共和国，卡斯塔诺和凤凰帝国的继承者，圣灵天选的人世摄政——您即安本纳尔之梦！
description.text_en:
An elf in Moonhaven was teaching his child about the common and elven languages: 'Unity means Anbennar! The elf-child asked, 'Then... so what does Anbennar mean?' His father smiled, and answered: 'Oh, you silly girl! Anbennar means a bunch of pompous aristocrats who can't agree on anything!'

Once upon a time, the Empire of Anbennar was a joke. Yet another failed political enterprise. Great in theory, but destined for the dustbin of history.

No longer.

Delian Whitecloak's dream was not a simple fantasy, soon forgotten in the morning. There would be peace on the Dameshead. There would be peace for Cannor. And the world of Halann would know peace.

Most serene and venerable Emperor, Heir to the Damerian Republic, Castanor, and the Phoenix Empire, Chosen Regent of the Divine - yours is the dream of Anbennar!

description.text:
安本纳尔帝国始于灰元1221年的阿兰蒂尔峰会。

对于一小群志同道合的法师和支持他们的坎诺贵族而言，嘘语密谋的时代已经结束。他们将领袖德利安·白笠拥立为安本纳尔帝国的首位皇帝。数十年来，甚至数个世纪以来，月神之首周围的土地除了战争和混乱之外一无所有——一些精灵战士自从来到坎诺之后，就再也没有见过持久的和平。德利安·白笠和他的同僚们设想了一个结束无尽冲突的办法，通过一种可以击穿任何国王、任何军队的力量来实现：魔法。

空位期持续了60年。六个月内，它就结束了。从维特斯克到弗恩，从比佩克到本农，军阀们在团结统一的大旗下搁置了他们的分歧和长期的争斗。虽然不得不通过支配或毁灭来迫使许多人这样做，但最终他们都欢迎新的和平。

从那时起，法师们对帝国的事务就有着不可估量的影响力。只有法师才能登临鸽座，魔法能力是合法继承的必要条件。即便历经统治权之战，法师皇帝的统治宣告终结，法师们被统治坎诺大部分地区魔法机构的魔法师议会所取代，但后者在长达数个世纪里仍一直掌控着帝国选侯之一的身份。虽然这种影响多年来时好时坏，但超凡之人掌控的非凡之力可以改变世界的观念一直存在。

安本纳尔，崛起吧！和平将再次到来!
description.text_en:
The Empire of Anbennar was first established at the Grand Summit of Aranthíl in 1221 AA.

For a small group of like-minded mages and their supporters among the Cannorian nobility, the time of secrecy had ended. They declared their leader, Delian Whitecloak, the first Emperor of Anbennar. The lands around the Dameshead had known naught but war and chaos for decades, even centuries - some elven warriors hadn't seen a lasting peace since their arrival in Cannor. Delian Whitecloak and his compatriots envisioned an end to the endless conflict, brought about through a force that could cut through any king, any army: magic.

The Interregnum lasted sixty years. In six months, it was over. From Vertesk to Verne, from Beepeck to Bennon, warlords set aside their differences and their long standing feuds in the name of unity. Many had to be compelled to do so, through domination or destruction, but in the end they all welcomed the new peace.

Since then, mages have held incalculable influence over the Empire's affairs. Only a mage could sit the Dove Throne. Magical ability was a requirement for legitimate succession. Even when the regime of Mage-Emperors came to an end during the Wars of Rule, they were replaced by the Magisterium, which ruled over the institutions of magic throughout much of Cannor, and controlled an Imperial electorate for centuries. While that influence has waxed and waned over the years, the notion that extraordinary abilities wielded by extraordinary people can change the world has remained.

Anbennar, arise! There will be peace once again.

description.text:
在来自坎诺各地的政要聚集的人群中，在他们忠诚的支持者和胜利的将军们的出席下，安本纳尔集权后的第一任皇帝在银月的大宴会厅发表了演讲，该宴会厅为这一场合重新进行了装饰：宣布一个真正统一的帝国。他告诉他们，安本纳尔的未来将由银和钢来决定。

一张张五颜六色的脸眯着眼睛，抿起嘴唇——未来？皇帝说得好像伟大的任务还在前面，而不是在他们身后。他能说什么呢？这是一个简单而有效的修辞伎俩——好奇的听众们全神贯注地听着皇帝阐述他们的话的含义。

银是帝国的颜色，是其旗帜的颜色，是其钱币的颜色，是其外交的颜色。银代表月亮，或是代表卡斯特罗斯。半精灵白银家族留下了深远的影响，当然，他们的血统亦是如此。驱逐术士王的英雄银色大队的记忆在歌曲和故事中延续。银色的武器让邪恶无处遁形，银色的巧舌让帝国诸侯们走到一起。

钢更简单。弗恩的长矛、范伯里行会的火枪、吉伯德的枪支都是用钢打造的。钢来自泰尔盖尔的铸造厂和工匠之砧的锻炉。半百种不同的军事传统和工业实践的经验将为帝国迈向未来提供源源不绝的动力。
description.text_en:
Amongst an assembled crowd of dignitaries from all of Cannor, attended by their loyal supporters and victorious generals, the emperor of the now centralized Anbennar delivered a speech in the Grand Ballroom of the Silver Moon, which had been redecorated for the occasion: the proclamation of a truly united Empire. He told them that the future of Anbennar would be decided by silver and steel.

A colorful sea of faces squinted and pursed their lips - the future? The Emperor spoke as if the great task was still ahead, not behind them. What could he mean? It was a simple yet effective rhetorical gambit - the curious audience listened in rapt attention as the Emperor expounded on the meaning of their words.

Silver is the Empire's color, of its banners, of its coinage, of its diplomacy. Silver for the moon, or perhaps for Castellos. The influence of the half-elven Silver Families runs deep, as does, of course, their blood descent. The memory of the heroic Silver Band that expelled the Sorcerer-King lives on in song and story. Silver arms kept evil at bay, and silver tongues brought the imperial princes together.

Steel is simpler. Steel for the spears of Verne, for the muskets of the Vanbury Guild, for the guns of Giberd. Steel from the foundries of Telgeir and the forge of Anvilwright. The lessons of half a hundred different military traditions and industrial practices will power the Empire's march into the future.

description.text:
「安本纳尔」这个词在精灵语中意为「交融」或「团结」。在其核心，帝国的创始原则是一个理想主义的梦想，即非常不同的人可以走到一起。人类、精灵、矮人、半身人、侏儒——团结在一起。然而，这个梦想随着空位期的结束，被成千上万的人用鲜血换走了。三十年的和平之后是统治权之战，以及三十年的混乱和内战。1284年，帝国议会和选侯团成立，让帝国的各色人等都有发言权。

伊斯特拉洛尔，代表东部的贵族。
珍珠边地，代表西部的贵族。
比佩克，代表半身人，帝国境内数量最多的少数种族。
银锻炉，代表矮人，哈沃拉尔山脉的伟大矿工和匠人。
月港，代表精灵，帝国境内最有影响力的少数种族。
月神之冠，代表商人阶层，并在一段时间内代表北方的贵族。
最后，是代表法师以及帝国的前管理机构的魔法师议会。

然而，这也导致了冲突，达梅里亚大公席尔穆纳家族实际上通过其合法附庸选侯伊斯特拉洛尔和珍珠边地的支持，成功垄断了鸽座——这种情况是阿巴兰、威克斯和其他强大的领主永远无法完全接受的。丁香战争（1348-1443）几乎将帝国彻底撕裂。但是，尽管困难重重，帝国仍然团结一致，永远在一起。
description.text_en:
The word 'Anbennar' means 'communion' or 'unity' in Elven. At its heart, the founding principle of the empire is an idealistic dream that very different people could come together. Humans, elves, dwarves, halflings, gnomes - together. And yet this dream was bartered for in the blood of thousands with the end of the Interregnum. After thirty years of peace came the Wars of Rule, and thirty years of chaos and civil war. In 1284, the Imperial Parliament and the Electoral College were established to give the multifarious people of the Empire a voice.

Istralore, to represent the nobility of the east.
Pearlsedge, to represent the nobility of the west.
Beepeck, to represent the halflings, the most numerous minority.
Silverforge, to represent the dwarves, the great miners and craftsmen of the Havoral mountains.
Moonhaven, to represent the elves, the most influential minority.
Damescrown, to represent the merchant class, and, in time, the northern nobility.
And finally, the Magisterium, representing the mages, and the former governing body of the Empire.

Yet this too led to conflict, with the Silmuna Grand Dukes of Dameria practically guaranteed the Dove Throne by the support of the electors Istralore and Pearlsedge, their leal vassals - a situation that the powerful lords of Arbaran, Wex, and others would never fully accept. The Lilac Wars (1348-1443) very nearly tore the Empire apart for good. But despite all the odds, the Empire stands united, together, forever.

description.text:
条条大路通向卡斯托纳斯，但哈兰的诸海却通向月神之首。早在灰烬天空之日来临之前，这片平静的内海沿岸就已然布满了充满活力的贸易城市。灾难和随后发生的达梅里亚共和国、卡斯塔诺和侏儒议会之间的「落星战争」使该地区遭到了破坏，但这并没有持续太久。财富将继续从迪文哈尔流向月神之首两旁不断增长的城市。龙醒、白色瘟疫——在历史的进程中，这些灾难都敌不过地理和经济。旧城为新城腾出了空间，或者至少是提供了建筑材料。侏儒统治的比佩克被重建为半身人统治的比佩克。艾伦河口适合建城，于是一座城市拔地而起；不管维特斯克是由卡斯托纳斯还是加韦顿统治，也不管它的城楼是白色还是黑色。达梅纳斯让位于达穆森，而后者当大海将精灵的残余舰队带到月神之耳时，它被称为安本科斯特。

真的，这些宁静的海岸见证了历史的浪潮在它们之间的碰撞和汹涌。这里有帝国及其人民的遗产和命运。正如王冠诸族口耳相传那般，统治者创造历史，而财富缔造统治者。安本纳尔帝国将统治月神之首，并随之支配世界的财富。而接下来还会有什么呢？
description.text_en:
All roads led to Castonath, but the seas of Halann lead to the Dameshead. Even before the Day of Ashen Skies, the shores of this calm inner sea teemed with vibrant trading cities. The Ruin and the subsequent War of the Falling Stars between the Damerian Republic, Castanor, and the Gnomish Hierarchy laid waste to the region, but not for long. Wealth would continue to flow from the Divenhal to the ever-growing cities lining the Dameshead. The Dragonwake, the White Pestilence - in the course of history, these disasters were no match for geography and economics. The old cities made room, or at least provided construction material, for the new. The gnome-ruled Beepeck was rebuilt into a halfling-ruled Beepeck. The mouth of the Alen suited a city, and so a city arose; it did not matter if Vertesk was ruled from Castonath or Gaweton, or if its citadel tower was white or black. Damenath gave way to Damucen, which became known as Anbenncóst when the seas brought the elven Remnant Fleet to the Damesear.

Truly, these tranquil shores have seen the tides of history crash and rage amongst them. There is the legacy and the destiny of the Empire and its peoples. As the Crownsmen saying goes, a ruler makes history, but wealth makes a ruler. The Empire of Anbennar shall rule the Dameshead, and with it, the wealth of the world. And what else could come next?

description.text:
当1443年第四次丁香战争结束时，安本纳尔帝国处于一种悲惨的境地，洛伦特、加韦德和伊贝瓦尔肆意攫取与它交界处的领土，令帝国的边境千疮百孔。洛萨恩三世皇帝的士兵们进军穿过帝都安本科斯特，没有丝毫荣耀可言，而是带来了战争的烈焰，并掠走属于自己的战利品。玫瑰党和月党舔舐伤口，互相磨刀霍霍，选帝侯们公开无视皇帝的意志；也许洛萨恩三世在战场上是一位恐怖的强力法师，但他也是个老人，一个不流淌着白银家族血统的威克斯蛮子，只有人类的短暂寿命。很快，另一位更加强大而睿智，或者说，更愿意「原谅」和「妥协」的人，就会登临鸽座。毕竟，一个怀有支配和重建帝国意愿的伟大男人——或女人——的成功将以帝国诸侯们的特权为代价。倘若最坏的情况发生，诸侯们总是可以要求克洛坦提供一位「法律学者」以捍卫自己的权利，与帝国皇室再扯皮上几十年。

尽管如此，帝国——在某一派别的大力帮助下——还是振作起来。一种新颖的中央集权模式得到了小诸侯们的认同，可以保护它们免遭较大邻国的掠夺。数个世纪以来，公捐税的征收第一次获得成功。帝国议会被合并且精简为一个功能性的立法机构，并常设会议。帝国庄园和选帝侯都被纳入麾下，随着上诉特权的撤销，皇帝再次成为国度的至高权威。谁还会有异议呢？要么是个别独立的诸侯们的小小争斗......或者是一个目标统一、不可分割的单一国度，有着不可分割的目标，只向鸽座屈膝。
description.text_en:
The end of the Fourth Lilac War in 1443 saw the Empire in a sorry state, fraying at the edges as Lorent, Gawed, and Ibevar picked at the borders. Soldiers of Emperor Lothane III marched through the capital of Anbenncóst, not in glory, but amidst flames, and carrying away loot. The Rose and Moon Parties licked their wounds and sharpened their daggers, and the Electors all but openly disregarded the emperor's will; Lothane III may have been a terror on the battlefield, but he was an old man, a Wexonard without silver lineage, with only a human's lifespan. Another, stronger and wiser, or maybe one more willing to "forgive" and "compromise", would soon come into the Dove Throne. After all, the success of a great man - or woman - with the will to dominate and restructure the Empire would come at the expense of the Empire's privileged princes. And if worst came to worst, the princes could always call upon Crothán to furnish a 'legal scholar' to defend their rights in the Imperial Court for a couple of decades.

Nonetheless, the Empire - with some considerable help from a certain faction - pulled itself together. The smaller states agreed to a new model of centralization that would protect them from the depredations of their larger neighbors. A common tax was levied for the first time in centuries. The Imperial Parliament was consolidated and streamlined into a functional legislature, with a permanent session. The Imperial Estates and the Prince-Electors were brought to heel, and with the revocation of the Privilege Against Appeal, the Emperor was once again the supreme authority of the realm. And who could possibly dissent? It was either the petty strife of individual, independent princes... Or a single nation, with purpose indivisible, capitulating only to the Dove Throne.

description.text:
变革之风已经吹到了哈兰，安本纳尔的最终统一将是一个永远为后人所瞩目的事件。但安本纳尔不是一阵风，短暂，如同过眼云烟。

帝国的纹章是按四分法排列的：在第一和第四部分是达梅里亚的精灵化月亮，这是王国与随后大公国的象征。在纹章学中，这种定位通常是为最有声望的头衔保留的。月亮代表了帝国在达梅里亚共和国的根基，在月神之耳统治，其议会与古老的元老院相呼应。非正式地，而且只是在以前的程度上，月亮代表白银家族，特别是席尔穆纳家族。第二部分是银龙，卡斯特罗斯，代表卡斯塔诺，人类种族的古老帝国和月神之首的最初统治者。第三部分是贾赫帝国的黄金凤凰，其后裔杰西丝是统治现在形成帝国之地的最后一位大帝；她于1161年驾崩，其国度随之崩溃，进入了空位期。徽章上还有一只鸽子，叼着一根树枝：象征着和平。

达梅里亚、卡斯塔诺和凤凰帝国——安本纳尔的遗产覆盖了哈尔坎的大部分地区。即使是它在月神之首周围的核心领土，在历史上也是难以治理的——正如「统一者」所清楚的那样。重生的安本纳尔必须进一步改革其行政管理，采用新的技术和移动学说，以应对整个帝国的任何需求和任何威胁。

player_overview.avoid_if: 不愿先完成形成国门槛，讨厌被灾难和六项法案锁住后续任务，或只想连续快速征服的玩家。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 先取得月河形成条件，经营城市与帝国政治；中段管理阶层和法师灾难；后期发展火药工业、跨地区扩张并完成帝国统一续篇。
player_overview.overview: 帕沙埃内不是开局国：你先从月河城市或其他合格国家完成形成条件，再接手它独立的长篇任务树。新国家要平衡行会、贵族、教会与法师，参与帝国政治并建设城市工业。法师危机会迫使议会通过一连串紧急法案；渡过之后，奇械和黑火药成为新权力基础。终段可改为安本纳尔帝国，并选择共和国、皇权或黑火药形象。
player_overview.recommended_for: 喜欢长线帝国政治、议会阶层博弈、城市经济和奇械火药转型的玩家。
signature_features: 城市联盟的阶层协商与帝国首相政治，形成后仍是任务主线。
法师危机必须用六项紧急议会法案化解，拆塔、叛乱与奇械开放相互牵连。
B59专属事件改为Z01后，按曾为帕沙埃内继续帝国后篇，并选择不同国名形象。
player_overview.tagline: 把月河诸城的协商政治，锻造成能改写整个安本纳尔帝国的火药国家。

reasons: 从月河城市政治自然发展为帝国宪制斗争
法师危机及六项议会法案形成强转折
Z01后续与火药共和国／皇权形象选择延长战役
warnings: 灾难未结束前部分后续任务不可见
城邦前段与特定年代门槛可能有等待感

positive_indicators: 任务强调法律和先例约束领袖
城市与交通工业建设服务公共繁荣
以议会法案而非单一领袖命令处理国家危机
values.rationale: 法律约束领袖、城市建设、阶层协商和灾后公共秩序有正向证据；灾难中议会立法削弱法师阶层、拆除法师塔并引发武装叛乱，后期又积极控制帝国宗教机构，具体强制手段拉低尊严与克制。未因扩张、帝国化、火药或政体本身加减善恶分；实机分支结果未完整核定。
red_flags: 紧急法案拆除法师塔并引发法师叛军
帝国宗教机构可被当作政治工具
统一目标可能压过地方自治
